name: – Sabrina Repp – § 25 – Am 6
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 25. Emphasises the importance of preventing youth radicalisation by addressing social exclusion and a lack of opportunities, and by countering online radicalisation and recruitment by extremist actors, such as Hizb ut-Tahrir and the Muslim Brotherhood, that exploit socio-economic vulnerabilities to undermine democratic values; calls for targeted support, such as accessible counselling services, strengthened community-based youth work, and targeted inclusive measures for marginalised and under-represented young people;
